text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
If there's no space here either... then 
next is—

While taking a walk around the academy for 
a break, I spotted Karen Bouquet Doll 
looking around as if searching for 
something.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
No—not for someone. Actually, um. I was 
looking for a place where I could plant 
some seeds.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Yes—flower seeds. I brought them from 
home, and... I wanted to raise them in a 
sunny spot.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
—However... unfortunately, I haven't been 
able to find a place.
choice_data_list: Can't you grow them in your room?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
If possible—I was hoping for a place where 
everyone could see them.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they will bloom into beautiful 
flowers—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
So that they could bring comfort... to the 
many horse girls who hold dreams and work 
so hard every day.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
During training, before races—surrounded 
by rivals, one can't help but feel tense.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
But if just for a moment—no matter who 
they are—looking at the same flowers could 
bring a brief moment of peace, I thought.

Perhaps picturing that very scene, her 
calm expression grew even softer.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, you must be busy—I'm 
sorry for rambling on like this.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: I will look a bit more. —Please excuse me.

Giving a slight bow, Karen Bouquet Doll 
walked away. There was something fleeting 
about her departing figure.

Seeing her like that, I couldn't just 
leave her be, so I decided to help her 
find a spot.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Flower seeds... is it? Indeed, every spot 
seems to be full right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I do know of a spot that has some space, 
but... um, it doesn't get much sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help. If I 
find a good place, I'll let you know right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. If both flower beds and fields are 
full, then either we prepare a new spot, 
or—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look inside the dorms. That wouldn't 
require student council permission. You 
should ask the dorm head.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it's Bouquet, she's in Miho Dorm. The 
dorm head is Hishiama. If I run into her, 
I'll let her know.

I asked around among people who might 
know, but couldn't find a place to plant 
the seeds after all. Next up—
choice_data_list: ...I wonder if the dorm head is around?

text_block_list.text:
Following Air Groove's advice, as I was 
heading toward the dorm—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard from Flower-san that you've 
been looking for a place to plant the 
seeds for me.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Is it because... of what I said 
earlier...? —I'm sorry. I made you go out 
of your way.

I told her not to worry about it. Just 
that, as she had mentioned—
choice_data_list:
I thought it'd be wonderful to have a 
soothing place like that.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. The seeds will surely be 
happy too.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
To have someone searching so earnestly for 
a place where they can blossom.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh. I heard from Air Groove. You want to 
grow flowers inside the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Of course, go right ahead! We've got 
several open spaces, and I know you'd keep 
it tidy.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Really? —Ah, thank you so much, 
Hishiama-san. I will never forget this 
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating. ...So. Specifically, 
what kind of place do you need? Got any 
special requirements?
choice_data_list:
A place where they can grow freely and 
happily...
A place where many people can see them...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If such a place exists— that would be 
a great help. And also—somewhere with 
plenty of sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... —Fufu, yes. A sunny spot 
where many people can see them would be 
lovely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you should use the dorm's 
sunroom! One just opened up, actually.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
! A space opened up, you say? Thank 
goodness... If it's there, I'm sure it'll 
be perfect.

—In the sunroom. Planting the seeds in a 
small pot, Karen Bouquet Doll gently 
touches the soil.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush, okay? First, 
let's start with sprouting. Let's do our 
best—slow and steady.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: —I'll always be watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: (...And once they safely bloom,)

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
We'll have the kind Trainer-san who helped 
us praise you and say how pretty you are.
